title: Taiwan Chingguan Yihau may improve post-COVID-19 respiratory complications through PI3K/AKT, HIF-1, and TNF signaling pathways revealed by network pharmacology analysis.
authors: Huynh, Dung Tam Nguyen; Nguyen, Hien Thi; Hsieh, Chien-Ming
one_liner_zh: 该文通过网络药理学和分子对接研究中药复方对新冠后呼吸并发症的机制，核心是药物-靶点-通路分析，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The emergence of new SARS-CoV-2 variants with a higher contagious capability and faster transmissible speed has imposed an incessant menace on global health and the economy. The SARS-CoV-2 infection might reoccur and last much longer than expected. Thence, there is a high possibility that COVID-19 can cause long-term health problems. This condition needs to be investigated thoroughly, especially the post-COVID-19 complications. Respiratory tract disorders are common and typical complications after recovery. Until now, there has been a lack of data on specialized therapeutic medicine for post-COVID-19 complications. The clinical efficacy of NRICM101 has been demonstrated in hospitalized COVID-19 patients. This herbal medicine may also be a promising therapy for post-COVID-19 complications, thanks to its phytochemical constituents. The potential pharmacological mechanisms of NRICM101 in treating post-COVID-19 respiratory complications were investigated using network pharmacology combined with molecular docking, and the results revealed that NRICM101 may exert a beneficial effect through the three primary pathways: PI3K/AKT, HIF-1, and TNF signaling pathways. Flavonoids (especially quercetin) have a predominant role and synergize with other active compounds to produce therapeutic effectiveness. Most of the main active compounds exist in three chief herbal ingredients, including Liquorice root (Glycyrrhiza glabra), Scutellaria root (Scutellaria baicalensis), and Mulberry leaf (Morus alba). To our knowledge, this is the first study of the NRICM101 effect on post-COVID-19 respiratory complications. Our findings may provide a better understanding of the potential mechanisms of NRICM101 in treating SARS-CoV-2 infection and regulating the immunoinflammatory response to improve post-COVID-19 respiratory complications.
abstract_zh: 具有更高传染能力和更快传播速度的新型SARS-CoV-2变异株的出现，对全球健康和经济构成了持续威胁。SARS-CoV-2感染可能会复发，且持续时间远超预期。因此，COVID-19极有可能导致长期健康问题。这一状况需要深入调查，尤其是COVID-19后并发症。呼吸道疾病是康复后常见且典型的并发症。迄今为止，针对COVID-19后并发症的专门治疗药物数据仍然缺乏。NRICM101在住院COVID-19患者中的临床疗效已得到证实。鉴于其植物化学成分，这种草药也可能成为治疗COVID-19后并发症的有前景疗法。本研究采用网络药理学结合分子对接 (molecular docking) 的方法，探讨了NRICM101治疗COVID-19后呼吸道并发症的潜在药理机制，结果显示NRICM101可能通过三条主要通路发挥有益作用：PI3K/AKT、HIF-1和TNF信号通路。黄酮类化合物（尤其是槲皮素）起主导作用，并与其他活性化合物协同产生治疗效果。大多数主要活性化合物存在于三种主要草药成分中，包括甘草 (Glycyrrhiza glabra)、黄芩 (Scutellaria baicalensis) 和桑叶 (Morus alba)。据我们所知，这是首次关于NRICM101对COVID-19后呼吸道并发症影响的研究。我们的发现可能有助于更深入地理解NRICM101在治疗SARS-CoV-2感染及调节免疫炎症反应以改善COVID-19后呼吸道并发症方面的潜在机制。
